relations.myth: Ragnar slays the serpent guarding Þóra
relations.note: Ragnar kills Þóra’s guardian serpent using protective hairy clothing and wins her.
Ragnar kills the serpents with spear and sword while wearing frozen hairy garments.

relations.myth: Ragnar anticipates reception in Óðinn’s hall
relations.note: Ragnar’s dying poetic persona expects Óðinn to prepare the hall for him.

relations.myth: Ragnar anticipates drinking with the Æsir
relations.note: Ragnar’s dying poetic persona expects to drink ale among the Æsir.
